amendments.summary: DI-role rule calibrated on development data only (sets 1-2 and set 3 development: 177 DI->amp and 66 two-mic/two-amp/DI-DI same-take pairs, 30 bands, leave-one-band-out). No rule kept most real DIs with <= 10% false accepts on all development negatives (first rule: 32% of DIs, 5%; driven rule: crunch 87%, high-gain 86%, clean 14%, 12%; any clean branch: >= 41% to keep most clean DIs). Set 6 is unusable for DI-based tests; every part is excluded; the failed rules are not applied to MedleyDB. Steven Clark RAW_01_04 -> 01_02 is labelled electric bass.

DIs labelled by ear (docs/set6-di-labelling-plan.md). The first round (74 questions) failed its hidden-check rule (1 of 6). A validation round, declared before it was built, passed: 10 of 10 confident answers right, no letter on any of 4 decoys. So the first round's confident labels count for groups that read crunch or high-gain (set 3's classifier, amp against labelled DI, whole tracks): 6 groups from 4 songs. Each gives one part (DI = the labelled track, reference = the scorer's same-take partner); set 5's exclusions apply. Clean DIs are still not established.

first_round.verdict: unusable by the declared rule (at least 5 of 6 hidden checks right)

validation_round.rule: at least 8 confident answers (a letter), at least 90% of them right; a letter on a decoy counts as wrong; if it passes, confident first-round labels count for groups whose gain class is crunch or high-gain; clean labels stay unused

amendments.parts_rule: one part per counted group; slug <song>-<DI>-labelled, so the first declaration's crops keep their slugs and stay superseded

use: DI parts from ear-labelled DIs only (amendment 2): crunch in scope, high-gain report-only; no clean DI established (amendment 1: no automatic DI-role rule); a song-only use (released mixes, no DI) needs its own declaration and crop rule
precedent: docs/validation-set5.md (rules, crop rule 2, judge lag, scope); the inventory came first, as set 5's did; MedleyDB names no DI, so a DI-role rule is added

rules.same_take: waveform test (>= 80% of 20-s windows in step, median peak-to-sidelobe >= 2.0), as sets 3-5; every pair of electric-guitar raw tracks of a song tested

di_role.status: no automatic DI-role rule (amendment 1); DIs labelled by ear, counted only for crunch and high-gain groups after the validation round passed (amendment 2)
di_role.labelled: docs/set6-di-labelling-plan.md; reference = the labelled DI's same-take partner with the smallest lag, then the higher peak-to-sidelobe ratio

first_declared.fixed: 2026-10-12, after the pairing statistics of 4 songs (AlexanderRoss_GoodbyeBolero, BigTroubles_Phantom, MusicDelta_Rock, Snowmine_Curfews) were seen; before any crop
first_declared.orientation: the earlier track of a same-take pair is the DI candidate; the later track its amp track
first_declared.acoustic_path: the amp track is 3 samples to 5 ms later than the DI (<= 2 samples: no acoustic path, DI and microphone cannot be told apart; > 5 ms: a distant microphone)
first_declared.driven_branch: the pair reads crunch or high-gain (set 3's classify.py, DI -> amp) and the DI's 1-s crest is >= 3 dB above the amp track's
first_declared.clean_branch: the pair reads clean, the DI's 5-10 kHz share (against 0.2-4 kHz) is >= 6 dB above the amp track's, and the pair is not on a stem labelled 'distorted electric guitar' only (a linear pair there is two microphones)
first_declared.reference: among a DI's role-passing amp tracks: the closest (smallest lag), then the higher peak-to-sidelobe ratio; the others are alternates (set 4's 'Close' preference, by lag)

rules.other_exclusions: an amp track that is also the amp track of another DI
rules.split: every band held out: no draw, no folds

scope.rule: a part's session-level gain_class: clean and crunch parts are in scope; high-gain parts are reported, never counted in a set-6 decision

rules.crop: crop rule 2 ('di-activity'), 10 s, 48 kHz mono, docs/validation-datasets.md; plus the same 10 s of the song's released mix
rules.lag_sign: positive when the amp track is later than the DI
rules.band_weighting: recommended as set 3's amendment (4): each band's parts weigh 1/n; a confirmation plan adopts or overrides it explicitly

provenance.archive_checks: each archive streamed from Zenodo, its whole-file SHA-256 and MD5 recorded (MedleyDB_V*.tar.gz.checksums) and the MD5 checked against Zenodo's by the user; only the mix and electric-guitar raw tracks were extracted; the archive was not kept

provenance.selection: eguitar_songs.json: songs whose metadata lists an electric-guitar raw track; 73 of its 166 songs are in the V1/V2 audio releases
